text:
Jordan: Quick sync — Channel partner asked for a single risk/obligation heatmap for the shared POC. need to surface blockers before legal call tomorrow.
Mira: Can you paste the partner's checklist? I only have the high-level ask — they want tenant isolation + telemetry retention options.
Alex: forwarding PDF from partner @Mira — key asks: 90d logs retention, SOC2 section, and pricing bands for 10k vs 100k reqs/day.
Jordan: copied snippet:
> They need a clear mapping: who owns egress, who pays for dedicated vs burst, SSO/SCIM flow, and fallback SLA if model falls back to open weights.
Sam: ops note — dedicated pools require a separate VPC peering. egress still billed to partner account unless we host in our dedicated tenant. that'll change pricing.
Mira: security Qs: KMS/HSM support, key rotation cadence, and data masking for embeddings. legal also asked for subprocessor list.
Alex: partner asked for a rough delta in cost if we enable KV caching + 8-bit quant. any ballpark numbers? they want to show ROI to their finance team.
Sam: rough: batching + KV cache could cut inference cost ~35% for conversational workloads; quant (8-bit) another ~20% but depends on model. I'll add disclaimers.
Jordan: can someone draft a 1-pager heatmap: columns = requirement, owner (Redwood/Partner), impact, blocker? then we can drop into the call.
Mira: I can start a table. quick format suggestion:
```
Requirement | Owner | Impact | Blocker
SSO (SAML) | Partner/Redwood | High (onboarding) | certs + IdP metadata
Telemetry export | Redwood | Medium | retention limits + schema
Dedicated GPU pool | Redwood | High (perf) | infra quota + pricing
Data residency | Partner | High | VPC config + legal
```
Jordan: perfect. Alex — can you confirm partner's committed QPS? Sam needs that for sizing.
Alex: they committed to 15k daily active requests initially, spike to 80k during trials. told them we can do staging burst but prod needs reserved capacity.
Sam: for 15k/day conversation with 15 token avg, staging can be handled in shared pool. For 80k spikes we'll recommend Dedicated with autoscale window. I'll put numbers: 1x small GPU pool (~p4) vs 3x for spikes.
Mira: security questionnaire items I'm pulling now. flagging two enterprise blockers: 1) partner demands customer-managed KMS for keys, 2) full list of subprocessors + SOC2 evidence.
Jordan: legal already requested SOC2 attestation PDF. Alex pls send partner our latest SOC2 + ISO summary.
Alex: sent via email, also dropping link in thread: https://redwood.example.com/compliance/SOC2_latest.pdf
deploy-bot: Deployment check: no active quotas blocking for this partner tenant. estimated infra lead time for Dedicated: 7 business days.
Sam: note on fallback model variant: we can route to a lower-cost Llama-like model on capacity constraints, but output quality may degrade. partner needs to approve fallback policy.
Mira: I'll add fallback approval checkbox to the heatmap.
Jordan: let's aim to have the heatmap + cost delta + security packet by EOD PT. Alex — can you prep a short slide for pricing bands? 2 slides max.
Alex: on it. will include conservative and aggressive cost scenarios with assumptions.
Mira: pinging again — partner also wants 3rd-party pen-test history. I have the redacted summary, adding link.
Jordan: great. after we post the doc I'll schedule 30m call with partner + their security lead. thanks team :thumbsup:
